primary_insight: Science treats the calibration sample as exchangeable with the unobserved remainder. When the remainder is generated by a different process, more n on the calibration generator cannot identify the target. The 22 Jun 2026 Nature isotopes of 3I/ATLAS (D/H 15σ above Solar System comets) are the cleanest generator split in the 2026 record that no prior archive class owns.

notes: SURVIVE Attack1: more_n_closes(G_cal)=False. Undersampling of ISOs is real and is the discriminator (4th ISO). EFC remainder is template-lock of G_cal. Cordiner 15σ vs SS mean is a generator split, not an empty cell.

SURVIVE Attack2: existence of Asgards is prior IP. Remainder is that the anoxic catalogue was the wrong generator; expanding generators changed the eukaryogenesis template. Ancestor-was-aerobic remains UNPROVED.
SURVIVE Attack3: coverage fraction zeroed as undersampling. Remainder is non-exchangeability of the filled cells (3-country EEZ generator). ODL's stratified 10,000-site plan is a tacit EFC admission.
SURVIVE Attack4: recency ablation leaves leader=iso-3i-atlas.
CITATION LOCK: Cordiner reports D/H=(0.98±0.06)% = 15σ above SS comet mean 0.029%. This engine does not re-derive σ_SS. Do not quote a homemade sigma.

ranking.title: 3I/ATLAS isotopic generator ≠ Solar System comet generator
ranking.g_cal: Solar System comet D/H and 12C/13C (n=thousands of local ices)
ranking.g_target: Interstellar-object ices (n=3 confirmed ISOs; 1 with JWST isotopes)
ranking.source: Cordiner et al., Nature, 22 Jun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10771-6. D/H=(0.98±0.06)%; 15σ above SS comet mean 0.029%. 12C/13C 141–191 (CO2), 123–172 (CO). Formation ≲30 K; possibly ~12 Gyr. Unlike any Solar System body.
ranking.note: More Solar System comets cannot identify ISO chemistry. 4th ISO is the discriminator, not more local ices.

ranking.title: Heimdallarchaeia oxic-coastal generator ≠ anoxic-deep Asgard prior
ranking.g_cal: Anoxic / oxygen-free Asgard samples (the first catalogue)
ranking.g_target: Oxygen-tolerant Heimdallarchaeia in coastal sediments and water column
ranking.verdict: ELIGIBLE remainder after Deep-biosphere-as-space-prior / Dark Biosphere (existence of Asgards)
ranking.source: Appler et al., Nature 652:405–415, 18 Feb 2026, doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10128-z. 404 Asgard MAGs; 136 new Heimdallarchaeia; aerobic ETC IV, haem biosynthesis, ROS detox. Closest eukaryotic relatives enriched in variably oxygenated coastal sediments.
ranking.note: Expanding beyond the anoxic generator changed the eukaryogenesis template. Ancestor aerobic respiration still UNPROVED (proposal).

ranking.title: Deep-sea visual sample is a 3-country EEZ generator, not the ocean
ranking.g_cal: Dives within 200 nm of US/Japan/NZ (65% of all visual observations)
ranking.g_target: Global deep seafloor including high seas and non-aligned EEZs
ranking.verdict: ELIGIBLE remainder after Undersampling (WHERE we look)
ranking.source: Bell et al., Science Advances 2025: 0.0006–0.001% of deep seafloor seen; 65% of observations within 200 nm of US/Japan/NZ; 97% of dives by 5 countries. ODL Global Deep Sea Exploration Goals, Science Advances 1 Apr 2026: 10,000 stratified sites — a non-random sample, i.e. an admission the filled cells are not exchangeable with the empty ones.
ranking.note: Undersampling owns empty cells. EFC remainder: the filled cells are a different process (wealthy-nation EEZ, hydrothermal/nodule bias). Random more-n from the same 5 fleets will not identify G_target. Stratified new generators will.

ranking.title: Deep-shale fungal generator ≠ surface 'eukaryotes are scarce underground' prior
ranking.verdict: ELIGIBLE remainder after Dark Biosphere (existence of deep life)
ranking.source: ISME Journal, 24 Aug 2026: 4.2e3–6.8e3 fungal cells ml⁻¹ in methane-producing shale; 689 fungal OTUs, 6 phyla; 205 isolates; 13 candidate novel taxa. Median fungal:bacterial biomass 1:4.7 using oceanic conversion factors.
ranking.note: Dark Biosphere owns 'life is down there.' EFC remainder: the functional template (fungi scarce, bacteria dominate) was a surface generator. Conversion factors themselves may be non-exchangeable — noted, not load-bearing.

ranking.title: Earth-photic biosignature templates ≠ exoplanet generating chemistry
ranking.g_cal: Earth surface photosynthetic O2/CH4/vegetation spectral library
ranking.verdict: ELIGIBLE remainder after CIP (coupling) / NASA gap list (spoken as false-positive inventory)
ranking.overlap_class: CIP (coupling) / NASA gap list (spoken as false-positive inventory)
ranking.source: NASA ExEP Science Gap List, Jul 2025; NASA-DARES 2025 Living Worlds white paper arXiv:2601.06386 (10 Jan 2026): biosignature interpretation requires a false-positive/false-negative framework still incomplete. 3I/ATLAS shows extra-solar chemistry is not Solar-System-like.
ranking.note: A complete false-positive list built only from Earth photic chemistry is still G_cal. Distinct from CIP (instrument coupling) — this is the prior, not the spectrometer.

ranking.title: Small TNO generator ≠ large-TNO planet-formation calibration
ranking.g_target: Webb/Hubble faint TNOs down to ~5 km
ranking.source: NASA Hubble+Webb, Astronomical Journal, 8 Sep 2026. 27 new dim TNOs; smallest ~5 km; fewer very small bodies than some planet-formation models expected.
ranking.note: Models trained on the bright end are not exchangeable with the faint generator. Could still be a completeness function (undersampling). Tax accordingly.

ranking.title: Well-sampled gyre carbon generator ≠ land-ocean-ice interface generator
ranking.g_cal: Open-ocean gyre air-sea flux time series
ranking.g_target: Coastal, riverine, permafrost, polar ice-driven carbon exchanges
ranking.verdict: ELIGIBLE remainder after Undersampling + JAC (land-ocean continuum)
ranking.source: IOC-R Report, IOC/UNESCO, 23 Feb 2026, Ocean Sciences Meeting Glasgow. Ocean absorbs ~25% of anthropogenic CO2; models diverge 10–20% globally, more regionally. Focus area 3: carbon exchanges across the land-ocean-ice continuum.
ranking.note: More gyre floats will not identify ice/river/coast generators. Tax JAC/undersampling heavily.

ranking.title: Bird CRY4 magnetosensitivity ≠ human CRY2 as a sense
ranking.verdict: ELIGIBLE remainder after TAC (receptor) / CMC (pigeon vestibular)
ranking.source: Conversation 22 Sep 2026: up to six candidate mechanisms; none confirmed as THE receptor. Chae 2025 Frontiers in Neuroscience: RF at 1.26 MHz reproduced a decision effect; author: replication required, not proof. UPRC already: explicitly not demonstrated.
ranking.note: Bird findings are not exchangeable with humans. Weak generator split; CMC/TAC framing is strong. Keep eligible but expect mid-rank.
